lines.en: label day142:
scene dayonefourtwo1
It’s another day in class and...everyone is actually looking at me for some reason.
In fact, Ayane isn’t even holding anything weird.
Is this what being a normal teacher feels like?
I don’t like it.
: Okay. What are you all up to?
: Is this one of those class-pranks that students just decide to play on the teacher? There’s not anything weird in my desk is there?
scene dayonefourtwo2
: I’ll check your desk if you want me to, Sensei! I’m really good at finding stuff I’m not supposed to find!
: That...what? What does that even mean?
: That’s Miku’s way of telling you that everything is normal, Sensei. We’ve all just decided to pay extra attention to you today.
: Yes, I see that. But why?
: Is this something Molly did? You guys never acted this way before she was here.
scene dayonefourtwo3
: Woah, hold your horses. I haven’t even said anything today!
: Yes, which is suspicious on its own given how much you had to say on your first day.
scene dayonefourtwo4
: That’s exactly why I’ve been so calm. You told me it was cool to go over the top but I’m pretty sure I went over the top of the top.
: Wouldn’t the top of the top be the-
: Actually, never mind. I don’t know what you’re all up to, but I don’t like it.
scene dayonefourtwo5
: Sensei.
: What, Ayane?
: How big is it?
: What?
: How big is it? We all want to know.
But...she knows exactly how big it is...
scene dayonefourtwo6
: I’d also like to know, Sensei! I need to plan accordingly.
if day139 == True:
And she knows as well...
else:
Even Chika? What the fuck is going on here?
: Is this something we’re really going to have a group discussion about?
scene dayonefourtwo7
: Well, if we’re all going to be in on it, shouldn’t you at least let everybody know?
And now I’m even being betrayed by my [niece].
: I’m not gonna lie, I’m normally pretty confident under most circumstances, but...
: It’ll be my first time doing something like this, so I’d at least feel a little more comfortable knowing how big it is beforehand.
scene dayonefourtwo8
: Umm...
: I know...how big it is...
: Even you?!
: Well...I’ve seen it before so...
: Okay, Futaba. I’m going to need you to stay quiet for a minute.
: I understand that some of you may have...seen or experienced things that you probably shouldn’t have, but I want you to know that-
scene dayonefourtwo9
: They’re not talking about what you think they’re talking about.
scene dayonefourtwo10
: Wait, how do you know what he’s thinking?
: Then what the fuck is everyone talking about?
scene dayonefourtwo11
: Sensei...
: Woah! We get to curse in here?!
: We’re not supposed to...
scene dayonefourtwo12
: Fuck yeah.
: Hey, not you. Only I’m allowed to do that.
: Sir, yes sir!
scene dayonefourtwo13
: Hey, can you just tell us how big it is already? Even I’m starting to get curious and I don’t even normally like that type of thing.
: Okay, I don’t know how all of you are managing to be so vague and so suggestive at the same time, but can someone please clarify what you’re asking for the size of?
scene dayonefourtwo14
: Oh. They’re talking about the place we’ll be staying when we all go to the beach.
: I told everybody about it over the[school] message-board.
: Okay, I have a few questions.
: First...We have a[school] message board?
: Yeah, why?
: Second, why are you actually communicating through it? Aren’t those sorts of things boring to [teenager]s?
: I guess a little bit. But for organizing group stuff it’s a lot easier than just texting everyone.
: Last question, isn’t it bad talking about a vacation your teacher is taking you on through a site that the rest of the staff can see?
: Makoto? Can you back me up on this? That’s a bad idea, right?
scene dayonefourtwo15
: Hmm...I suppose that could be easily misconstrued, yes. Ami was surprisingly smart about it, though. So I don’t think it will be an issue.
: Smart? Ami? Are you sure?
scene dayonefourtwo16
: Hey!
scene dayonefourtwo17
: Yes, I was surprised as well.
: Why does everyone think I’m dumb?! I’m smart!
: Well then, Ami...How exactly did you manage to tell everyone about a trip to the beach without making me sound like a suspicious individual?
scene dayonefourtwo18
: Code language. Instead of saying beach trip, I said ‘educational field trip.’
Oh. Well, I guess that is at least mildly smart. I’m surprised everyone else was able to catch on so easily, though.
But, then again, I’m sure that by now, they wouldn’t ever expect me to take them on a trip with any amount of educational value, so it’s all starting to make sense.
: So yeah, just tell everybody how big the place is gonna be and-
: Ami, I haven’t even booked the place yet. I don’t even know if I’ll be able to find one.
scene dayonefourtwo19
: Well...um...we’re talking about the beach in Kumon-mi, right?
: I mean, I guess so. I haven’t actually laid out any concrete plans yet.
: Well, if you do decide on that as where you want to bring us...I’ve been to the inn there with family before.
: It’s not very large, but I think we should be able to fit everyone in two or three rooms.
: Some of us will likely have to sleep on the ground, but...I think it can work.
scene dayonefourtwo20
: I don’t mind sleeping on the ground! I can sleep anywhere as long as I have a pillow.
scene dayonefourtwo21
: UM! I WILL ALSO SLEEP ON THE GROUND!
: I LOVE THE GROUND! IT IS MY FAVORITE PLACE TO SLEEP!
: I’m sure it is, Rin.
: I refuse to sleep on the ground. I’ll sleep in the bed with Ami and Ayane.
: Sensei can sleep on the bus.
scene dayonefourtwo22
: MY Sensei? Sleeping on a bus? Are you out of your mind?
: He’s going to sleep in the bed with me. You can sleep on the bus.
: If he’s actually going to be sleeping in the bed with you then yes, I will sleep on the bus.
: You’re all still getting a little ahead of yourselves. It will probably be a while before I can even book anything.
scene dayonefourtwo23
: Would you like me to handle that for you, Sensei? I’m already doing pretty much everything else, so one more thing won’t bother me.
: I mean, if you’re okay with it, sure.
scene dayonefourtwo24
: Hehe...It’s kind of like I’m becoming your secretary too~
scene dayonefourtwo25
: Pardon my interjection, Master, but we Irish folk don’t typically handle the sun all too well.
: Would you be willing to find the time in your busy schedule to nurse me back to health should I happen to fall ill?
: Just wear sunscreen, Molly.
: But I don’t have any sunscreen.
: Then go buy some.
: But I don’t have any money.
: Then bring a parasol or something.
scene dayonefourtwo26
: I will bring two in order to compensate for how weak and sensitive my European skin is.
: Sounds great.
: So, can we go back to normal now that I’ve been forced into confirming that I’ll take you all to the beach?
scene dayonefourtwo27
: Oh, actually, do you mind if I come talk to you for a second, Sensei?
: There’s something I want to...run by you if that’s okay.
: Huh? Yeah. That’s fine.
scene black
Rin shyly walks over to my desk and brings her voice to a near-whisper.
: Do you...mind if we actually talk in the hall?
scene dayonefourtwo28
: Sorry for calling you out here in the middle of class like that. You don't think it seemed weird, do you?
: Weird? Not really. Maybe a little unusual, but I doubt anyone really thought anything of it.
: R-Right...
: Well, umm...
scene dayonefourtwo29
: I’m...not really great when it comes to spending the night anywhere other than my dorm.
: Do you mind if I ask why?
scene dayonefourtwo30
: That’s exactly why I called you out here.
: So like, you know how I’m supposed to take medication and stuff to keep me from getting all blaaaaah or whatever?
: Of course.
To be fair, it’s kind of hard to forget after I saw her in that delirious state a while back.
: Well, being somewhere I’m not used to normally freaks me out a bit. I think it’s an anxiety thing.
: And it’s not like I’m gonna bail on the trip or anything like that. I think it sounds fun.
: But if I start acting all...you know...weird...
scene dayonefourtwo31
: Would you mind...maybe trying to calm me down a bit?
: Absolutely. How would I do that, though? You weren’t really that...consolable the last time I saw you in poor condition.
scene dayonefourtwo32
: I don’t know, man. Just...sit with me and pat my head or something. Preferably away from everyone else.
: Even Chika?
: Definitely Chika. Chika more than anyone. I can’t have her knowing I can get all weird like that.
: I’d never have a chance if she knew that side of me.
if chikadorm20 == True:
: That’s not true. Chika’s one of the most caring people I know. She’d never think less of you over something like that.
Rin stays quiet for a moment. I notice her fingers beginning to pluck at loose threads on her sweater before she locks her eyes with mine again.
scene dayonefourtwo33
: Sounds like...you’re getting to know her pretty well, huh?...
else:
: Do you really think she’s the type of person to just cut ties with you after finding out something like that?
: Well, no...But that doesn’t mean I’m comfortable with her knowing.
scene dayonefourtwo34
: Um, anyway! We should probably be getting back to class, right? People might think it’s serious if we’re out here for any longer.
: This...is kind of serious, though. Right?
scene dayonefourtwo35
: What? No! No way! Just a little heads up in case I get a little panicky. It’s nothing worth losing sleep over.
: I just...wanted you to know. That’s all.
scene black
Rin and I walk back into class and she immediately retreats to her desk as if none of this ever happened.
The rest of the[school] day carries on normally.
Except...
Now I have to figure out how I’m going to handle going on a mini-vacation with an entire class of [high_school] girls.
$ rin_love += 1
$ day142 = True
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
jump afterschoolevent
